name: @potyro/native
description: Capacitor target, Android + iOS (WP8 / KA-03): native capability impls (exact notifications, camera, geo, filesystem) + composition-root selection.

scripts.cap:add:android: cap add android && node scripts/patch-manifest.mjs && node scripts/pin-gradle.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: cap sync android && node scripts/patch-manifest.mjs && node scripts/pin-gradle.mjs
scripts.android: pnpm --filter @potyro/shell build:web && pnpm cap:sync && pnpm cap:open
scripts.ios: pnpm --filter @potyro/shell build:web && pnpm cap:sync:ios && pnpm cap:open:ios
